items.source:
Default is "false". Set this to "true" to synchronize cache put/evict
operations with ongoing Spring-managed transactions, performing the actual cache
put/evict operation only in the after-commit phase of a successful transaction.
items.translation: 默认为 "false"。将其设置为 "true" 可将缓存的 put/evict 操作与正在进行的 Spring 管理的事务同步，仅在成功事务的提交后阶段执行实际的缓存 put/evict 操作。

items.source: Base class for CacheManager implementations that want to support built-in awareness of Spring-managed transactions. This usually needs to be switched on explicitly through the setTransactionAware(boolean) bean property.
items.translation: CacheManager 实现的基类，这些实现希望支持对 Spring 管理事务的内置感知。通常需要通过 `setTransactionAware(boolean)` bean 属性显式开启此功能。

items.source: Decorate the given Cache object if necessary.
items.translation: 如有必要，则装饰给定的 Cache 对象。

items.source: Return whether this CacheManager has been configured to be transaction-aware.
items.translation: 返回该 CacheManager 是否已配置为事务感知。

items.source: Set whether this CacheManager should expose transaction-aware Cache objects.
items.translation: 设置此 CacheManager 是否应暴露支持事务的 Cache 对象。

items.source: cache - the Cache object to be added to this CacheManager
items.translation: cache - 要添加到此 CacheManager 的 Cache 对象

items.source:
the decorated Cache object to be used instead,
or simply the passed-in Cache object by default
items.translation: 使用装饰后的 Cache 对象，或者默认情况下直接使用传入的 Cache 对象。
